| C4 | medium | src/routes/books.ts:21 | HTMX endpoint returns no books for an empty or missing `q` instead of all books |
| C6 | medium | tests/routes/search.test.ts:1 | Required `tests/models/book-search.test.ts` is missing, and the route tests miss several cases |
